# FaithWall

> FaithWall is an iPhone app, free to download, that puts the Bible verses you choose on your lock screen. Using it requires a FaithWall subscription. You pick your own verse (book/chapter/verse or search, 24 translations) and show it as a lock-screen wallpaper, or in a lock-screen widget that shows that verse (an optional "Auto-rotate verses" setting, off by default, makes the widget show random verses instead). It has a built-in Bible browser (all books and chapters) for finding your verse, but it is not a study app.

## Key facts

- **What it is**: iOS app for daily Bible verses on the iPhone lock screen
- **Platform**: iPhone, iOS 15.0 or later (the lock-screen widget needs iOS 16)
- **Price**: Free to download; a subscription is required to use the app. Price, billing period and any trial offer are shown in the App Store before paying.
- **App Store**: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/lock-screen-bible-verse/id6756815070
- **Website**: https://faithwall.app
- **Author / Founder**: Karol Billik
- **Built by**: karchi. (https://www.karchi.xyz/)
- **Contact**: hello@faithwall.app
- **Minimum iOS**: 15.0 (the lock-screen widget needs iOS 16.0)

## Pricing

FaithWall is free to download, but using it requires a subscription (there is no free tier). The price, billing period and any trial offer are shown in the App Store before you pay, in your local currency.

Payments are handled by Apple through the App Store.

## How it works

You choose your own verse by book, chapter and verse or by search, in 24 translations. After subscribing you pick how to show it:
1. **Wallpaper**: a full-screen lock-screen wallpaper applied with an Apple Shortcut.
2. **Widget**: a compact lock-screen widget (iOS 16 or later) that shows the verse you picked. An optional "Auto-rotate verses" setting (off by default) makes it show random verses instead, changing every hour, every 8 hours or once a day.

The app interface is available in 10 languages. FaithWall is built for the lock screen: its built-in Bible browser is for finding and picking your verse.

## What makes it different

- **Single-purpose**: Most Christian apps try to do everything. FaithWall does one thing — your chosen Scripture on the lock screen.
- **Your verse**: You pick the verse for your wallpaper and the verse your widget shows. The wallpaper never changes by itself.
- **Changing the wallpaper**: To change it later, pick a new verse in the app (or tap Update Wallpaper Now in Settings after changing the text style). The app runs the Shortcut for you. It never changes in the background.
- **Two separate setups**: The wallpaper setup and the widget setup are separate setups you switch between in Settings. Auto-rotate verses exists only in the widget setup.
